allowUniqueBodyArmour.label: Allow unique body armour
allowUniqueBodyArmour.description: Allow permanent mercenaries to equip Unique Body Armours (3.26 parity; native drag and Ctrl+click require the optional NativeMods client plugin, or use /merc326 equip on vanilla clients).

spawnInAllZones.label: Spawn in every combat zone
spawnInAllZones.description: Spawn a mercenary encounter in every campaign combat zone and map once the character has reached The Mud Flats, scaled to player level.

enableNobleBloodDamagePenalty.label: Noble Blood -30% damage penalty
enableNobleBloodDamagePenalty.description: Apply Luminary Noble Blood's 30% less Mercenary and Minion Damage penalty (off by default for 3.26 parity).

enableOathOfFealty.label: Oath of Fealty
enableOathOfFealty.description: Link skills cost 50% less, have infinite attachment duration, and you do not die when your linked permanent mercenary dies.

enableGoldenGlory.label: Golden Glory
enableGoldenGlory.description: Increases and reductions to Light Radius also apply to the buff effect of Link skills on your permanent mercenary.

enableLoyalBodyguard.label: Loyal Bodyguard
enableLoyalBodyguard.description: 20% of hit damage is taken from your nearest permanent mercenary before your Life or Energy Shield if their Life is higher; 40% of damage they take is recouped as Life if their Life is lower.

enableBestowedKnighthood.label: Bestowed Knighthood
enableBestowedKnighthood.description: Your permanent mercenary has 50% increased effect of non-curse auras from skills and 100% chance to taunt on hit.

enableLegendaryArmsDamageBonus.label: Legendary Arms damage bonus
enableLegendaryArmsDamageBonus.description: Your permanent mercenary and their minions deal 8% more damage per equipped unique item.

enableLuminarySmallNodes.label: Luminary small passive bonuses
enableLuminarySmallNodes.description: Grant all 7 Luminary small passives (+30% Mercenary and Minion maximum Life, +45% Mercenary and Minion Damage, +20% Link Skill Cast Speed, +35% Light Radius).
